_readme: Solana events shown on the Globe (app + website). Lu.ma and solana.com started refusing automated requests (HTTP 429) in Nov 2026, so this hand-kept list is the main source. Add upcoming events here (ISO dates in UTC, lat/lng of the venue city); past events drop off by themselves 7 days after they end. Editing this on master reaches phones and the website without an app update. Checked in the weekly research.
